name: Project Portfolio Management
summary: A plan registry and project-management tool: one recursive plan collection with an optional kind label, a Rust matcher library for explainable duplicate detection, a loco.rs REST service (governance, scheduling, cost, approvals, controlled documents), and a SvelteKit UI.

links.title: Skill commands

stack: Podman with Compose to run it
check: cd project-portfolio-management-service-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --lib
cd project-portfolio-management-ui-with-svelte && pnpm run check && npx vitest run && pnpm exec playwright test
rules: Spec first: a behavioural change is one commit with a spec edit, a code edit and a test edit.
Say plainly what is not built or not tested.
Stage named files; run scripts/generate-status.sh after adding tests.
